doors.label: Unlatch refuge return
doors.lockedPrompt: Return door · Latched from the service side

readings.label: Read expedition notice
readings.title: Expedition notice · Bring back the reel
readings.text:
The survey team has gone quiet. Their last field log is in the room at the far end of this corridor. Start there; it should tell us where they left the recording.

Take what you need before leaving. Dressings are beside the case on the left desk; cartridges are on the right table. Open your field case to use supplies, or load a packet with {key.secondary} while holding the pistol; {key.swapHands} swaps what your hands hold.

The residents give warning before they strike. Step back, use a doorway, and make your opening count. There is something answering the bell in the linen room, too.

Bring the survey reel back to the notebook on the left desk. Recording a return secures your finds and saves the whole excursion. Leaving without recording loses changes since your last return.

readings.label: Read field log
readings.title: Field log · The long way back
readings.text:
The wallpaper changes before the corridor does. Mark the door, not the pattern.

We left the survey reel in its blue case in the service workroom, behind the refuge. The passage east of this room runs behind the guest rooms to reach it.

The return door only unlatches from the service side. Leave it open. Next time, take the short way.
